purpose.pilot5: five complete train-only pilot epochs from fresh weights; learn an independent absolute E8M0 scale shared by the E2 modes, initialized once to the initial E4 scale x64; unchanged E4 source and exponent/mantissa bit truncation
purpose.reference100: one hundred complete train-only epochs from fresh weights; learn an independent absolute E8M0 scale shared by the E2 modes through epoch100 without a freeze, initialized once to the initial E4 scale x64; unchanged E4 source and exponent/mantissa bit truncation

reporting_policy.pilot5: all three modes at epoch5 or actual final epoch and at the same E4M3-best checkpoint; compare only matched epochs against historical five-epoch references; no epoch100 accuracy claim
reporting_policy.reference100: all three modes at epoch100 or actual final epoch and at the same E4M3-best checkpoint; compare only matched observed epochs against historical references; partial runs never claim epoch100 completion
